name: Easy Cheesy Chicken Casserole with Mixed Veggies & Tater Tot Topping

ingredients.name: frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: Place frozen vegetables in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw, then transfer to a large bowl. Add chicken, soup, milk, sour cream, and seasoning, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (340 g) bag frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)
454 g cooked chicken (shredded)
1 (737 g) can condensed cream of chicken soup
⅔ cup whole milk
½ cup sour cream
1 tbsp chicken seasoning blend

instructions.primary_message: Transfer chicken mixture to a large baking dish and top with an even layer of tater tots. Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until filling is bubbling and tater tots are golden and crispy, 40-45 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (794 g) bag tater tots or puffs, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Remove casserole from the oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
